source.text: Raymond VI( October 27, 1156 – August 2, 1222) was Count of Toulouse and Marquis of Provence from 1194 to 1222. He was also( as Raymond IV) Count of Melgueil from 1173 to 1190.
source.title: Raymond VI, Count of Toulouse

source.text: Constance of Toulouse was the daughter of Raymond VI, Count of Toulouse and his second wife Beatrice of Béziers. She first married Sancho VII of Navarre in 1195, but they were divorced in 1200. After the annulment she remarried to Peter Bermond II of Sauve. With her second husband, Constance had the following children:
